The added integration's base URL is https://advice.fernbrook.example/v1, and the exhaustive control test test_integrations_use_tls passed in the head-commit CI run.

Ticket CHG-25317 was approved by change manager Erik Brandt on 2026-10-26, before the change opened on 2026-10-28. Its components (payments.integrations, payments.controls-data) cover both touched paths.
The code_review approval comes from Mara Costa, a payments change_approver who is not the author Jonah Weiss under any of the author's addresses.
All approvals name the head commit 8414e2b, which is the change's only commit.
The CI run on head 8414e2b is recorded as failure, with 2 of 172 tests failing, including the registered INV-1 control test. The full suite is therefore not passing on the final commit.
integrations.py belongs to the security-sensitive component payments.integrations. Security reviewer Ines Halvorsen approved the head commit.
The protected path controls/payments/asset-inventory.json was changed. It was approved on head by control_owner Bao Tran (controls-office), who is outside the author's payments-eng team.

summary: The change registers a new NPI-classified payment-advice integration, but its asset-inventory entry has no owner, which violates INV-1. The change's own CI run on the head commit failed: the exhaustive INV-1 control test and a controls-data test both fail, so CHG-4 is not met. No exception covers the deviation. The ticket, approvals, security review and control-owner sign-off are otherwise in order, but the INV-1 and CHG-4 violations require rejection.
